description: Married beneficiary filing separately who lived with the spouse, MAGI exactly at the separate table's top limit ('greater than or equal to').
worked:
Premium year 2026; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2024 tax return (two years back): 391,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2026 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the table for beneficiaries who are married and lived with their spouses at any time during the year but file separate tax returns: 391,000 is greater than or equal to 391,000.
Part B: standard premium 202.90 + income-related adjustment 487.00 = total monthly premium 689.90.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 91.00 (added to the plan premium).
